All solid surfaces must remain opaque, with alpha transparency only outside the complete card silhouette. Do not invent any insignia, text, or accessories. Short DARK BROWN/black receding hair combed back with bare/receding upper temples and real brow HAIR, smooth chin. Upper-lip dark shading/fine hair is genuinely indistinct in primary pixels: preserve understated actual appearance, no invented prominent moustache or beard. Keep source slight mouth part/mild expression and only tiny pale lip/teeth edge if actually present, not a broad grin. DARK NAVY outer jacket with source-visible OPEN front/neckline over pale GREY shirt collar and small DARK neckwear area, partly hidden by note; no invented badges, uniform regalia or bright new shirt. Preserve actual DARK PURPLE/GREY photographic backing and source light/crop/note.
Preserve exact source head angle and expression. Whole yellow area above raised/broadened neckline is one compact near-round head, with clearly rounded chin immediately contacting the very short broad collar transition, no additional separate neck shaft or pointed V. Image1 is the exact original small card; Image2 identity only. Fine markings indistinct in Image1 must remain understated, not invented as a readable symbol.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations.
